title: Stop a scheduled task
description: Stop the running instance of a scheduled task

parameters.name: taskname
parameters.label: Task name
parameters.description: Name of the task to stop

examples.description: Run the action and return the resulting object for an immediate check. -PassThru confirms that the operation succeeded by showing the final status. Useful for scripts with error handling.
Force the action despite resistance (dependent services, protected processes, and so on). -Force bypasses some safeguards. Use it with care after checking the dependencies.
Example using the 'taskname' parameter: Name of the task to stop. Replace DailyBackup with the value that fits your environment.
Example using the 'taskpath' parameter: Task path. Replace \Microsoft\Windows\ with the value that fits your environment.

notes: Ends the run immediately. Use it with care on critical tasks.
